_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Mo ye zo {player_id} na kôsi ya LinesOfAction.
Zo ti mo ye '{side}', zo ti angbô ye '{other}'.
Format ya déplacement: `[b1b3]` (kötä zo ti kôsi na kotä zo ti déplacement). Déplacement ya lôi ye na ndö horizontal, vertical, ou diagonal, na kôme ya kare ya zo ti mbû (ndöngö zo ti mô) na ndö la. Mo ye déplacer na zo ti mo ye, mais pas na zo ti angbô; kotä na zo ti angbô ye kôsi ya capture.  Gagner lè tout zo ti mo ye ye 8-voisin connecté.

board.current_board: Bungbi ti azo so ayeke bâ lege ni: {board}

invalid_move.wrong_format: A lingbi a zia ni na yâ ti kode so e2e4 (ti londo, juska coordinate).
invalid_move.identical: Kötä zo ti source na kotä zo ti déplacement ye ndöngö.
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: A lingbi a gue na nduzu wala ti bâ ndo.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: A lingbi lo gue ayo tongana ti so a yeke tambela na yâ molongo.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Mbeni wato akanga lege na e.
invalid_move.destination_own: A yeke mbeni ye so a zia na yâ ti ndo ni.

outcome.draw_no_capture: A gue na lo 60 sân ti gbu mbeni zo.
outcome.draw_repetition: A kiri ti fa ndo ni fani ota.
